Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: After an unsuccessful attempt to retrieve the actual 2020 Nature article count, WebSurfer switched to an unjustified estimate of 1500 research articles and suggested using it for the calculation. This premature assumption (instead of verifying the true count of ~1024–1025) propagated through to the final result, yielding 60 instead of the correct 41.
